name: featurephone-port
description: Remake an original WIPI/KTF, LGT, SKT or J2ME feature-phone game .jar as a native Android app on a forked wie emulator core: archive repair, core porting, guest reverse engineering, multi-build support, the touch host layer, gamepad and audio, save-data integrity, dead-server revival or in-process retirement, signing and a publish audit.
